name: tossie-app
//: React 18 and Vite 5 are pinned to match reoperative (~/Downloads/realtygrind) so its dialer, messages and SDR components port in without a framework migration on top of the port.
//softphone: @twilio/voice-sdk is the one dependency the dialer could not be written without: a browser cannot originate a WebRTC leg into Twilio without their signalling client, and there is no smaller shim for it. Same ^2.18.1 range reoperative runs, so its BrowserDialer's hard-won workarounds (codec order, edge pinning, speakerDevices) apply here unchanged.
